definitions.draw: function draw(){context.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);context.clearRect(0,0,width,height);const scanY=((activeTime%scanDuration)/scanDuration)*(height+44)-22,glitch=glitchFrames>0;context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.fillStyle='#fa7319';for(const particle of particles){const flicker=.75+.25*Math.sin(activeTime*.0042+particle.phase),distance=Math.abs(particle.y-scanY);context.globalAlpha=flicker;context.fillRect(particle.x-1,particle.y-1,2,2);if(distance<22){context.globalAlpha=flicker*.4*(1-distance/22);context.fillRect(particle.x-1,particle.y-1,2,2)}}if(glitch){context.fillStyle='#67e8f9';for(const particle of particles){context.globalAlpha=.22+.12*Math.sin(activeTime*.004+particle.phase);context.fillRect(particle.x-3,particle.y-1,2,2)}context.fillStyle='#f472b6';for(const particle of particles){context.globalAlpha=.2+.1*Math.cos(activeTime*.004+particle.phase);context.fillRect(particle.x+1,particle.y-1,2,2)}}context.globalAlpha=1;context.globalCompositeOperation='source-over'}
